newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Preston can't explain share rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Preston can't explain share rise.

text.p: Minerals explorer Preston Resources NL said on Thursday it is not aware of any reason for the rise in the company's share price other than the option it has to acquire the unlisted Lagoon Hill Nickel NL.
Last week, Preston was granted an option to acquire the Marlborough Lateritic Nickel Cobalt project by acquiring all the issued shares in Lagoon Hill.

Preston said it was aware of market rumours concerning Lagoon Hill Nickel NL and Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd, but it is not aware of any details of the rumour. Earlier a trading halt was applied to Preston Resources shares.

"In accordance with your request I confirm that there is no substance to the rumour concerning Lagoon Hill Nickel NL and BHP and there is no explanation that the company can provide for the origins of the rumour. The company is not aware of any details of the rumour," Preston said in reply to a query from the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).
It said it intends to make a further announcement in the next week or so.
The ASX queried Preston's shares after they rose from A$1.23 on Wednesday to A$1.45 on Thursday.
Preston shares were 17 cents up at A$1.40 before a trading half was applied to the shares.
